prompt: Create a square close-up anime portrait sticker of a cute virtual idol maid girl facing forward against a very pale lavender background. Show only the head, shoulders, and upper chest, centered and symmetrical, with an oversized chibi-like head and soft delicate line art. The character has long twin-tails with cotton-candy pink hair with bright cyan-blue streaks and blue tips, straight blunt bangs, two braided side sections, and large white animal ears rising behind the hair. Add a white frilly maid headband with a small sailor-style cap at the top, displaying a bold black anchor emblem. Include exactly two large side hair accessories: black-and-white frilled rectangular maid clips with pale gray bows and dangling ribbons. Her expression is sad and teary: half-lidded purple-pink sparkling eyes, visible tears at both lower eyelids, flushed cheeks, tiny downturned mouth, and a vulnerable pout. Dress her in a white frilly maid outfit with a high ruffled collar, off-shoulder sleeves barely visible, black trim on the bodice, and one prominent pale lavender bow at the neck. Use a soft pastel VTuber fan-art style, glossy eyes, gentle blush gradients, clean cel shading, subtle highlights in the hair, no text, no watermark, no extra characters, and keep the composition tightly cropped like a digital sticker or emote.

promptZh: 创作一张正方形的动漫近景头像贴纸，主角为 一位可爱的虚拟偶像女仆女孩，正面对着镜头，背景为极浅的淡紫色。画面仅展示头部、肩膀和上胸部，居中且对称，采用超大 Q 版头部比例和柔和细腻的线条。角色留着长双马尾，发色为 棉花糖粉色，带有明亮的青蓝色挑染和蓝色发梢，留着整齐的齐刘海，两侧有两条编发，头发后方竖起一对白色大兽耳。头戴白色荷叶边女仆发箍，顶部配有一顶小型水手帽，帽上印有醒目的黑色船锚标志。两侧各有一个大型发饰：黑白相间的荷叶边矩形女仆发夹，配有浅灰色蝴蝶结和垂下的丝带。表情悲伤且泪眼婆娑：半睁的紫粉色闪亮双眼，下眼睑处有明显的泪水，脸颊泛红，小巧的嘴角下垂，呈现出脆弱的嘟嘴神态。身穿白色荷叶边女仆装，配有高领荷叶边，隐约可见露肩袖，胸衣带有黑色滚边，颈部系有一个显眼的淡紫色蝴蝶结。采用柔和的粉彩 VTuber 同人画风，眼睛光泽感强，脸颊有柔和的腮红渐变，干净的赛璐珞阴影，发丝带有细腻的高光，无文字，无水印，无其他角色，构图紧凑，呈现出数字贴纸或表情包的效果。
